description: Source code for the CostCenter class in ERPNext, managing cost center data including validation, conversion, and renaming logic.

classes.name: CostCenter
classes.description: Represents a cost center with validation, conversion, and renaming functionalities, inheriting from NestedSet.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates a unique name for the cost center based on its number and name.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the cost center data.

methods.name: validate_distributed_cost_center
methods.description: Validates distributed cost center constraints and data integrity.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Checks mandatory fields like parent cost center.

methods.name: validate_parent_cost_center
methods.description: Ensures the parent cost center is a group node.

methods.name: convert_group_to_ledger
methods.description: Converts a cost center from group to ledger if conditions are met.

methods.name: convert_ledger_to_group
methods.description: Converts a cost center from ledger to group if conditions are met.

methods.name: check_gle_exists
methods.description: Checks if there are existing GL entries for the cost center.

methods.name: check_if_child_exists
methods.description: Checks if the cost center has child nodes.

methods.name: check_if_part_of_distributed_cost_center
methods.description: Checks if the cost center is part of a distributed cost center.

methods.name: before_rename
methods.description: Pre-rename processing, including adding company abbreviation and validation.

methods.name: after_rename
methods.description: Post-rename updates to cost center name and number.
